claudeCoder.modelLadder.description: Escalation ladder, cheapest first. Escalation restarts the task on the next model.

claudeCoder.autoTaskDetection.description: Use a cheap Haiku call to detect task changes and auto-reset the session.

claudeCoder.useSubscription.description: Deprecated — superseded by claudeCoder.backendPreference (kept for back-compat; only read when backendPreference is unset). Run tasks through the Claude Agent SDK using your Claude Code login (Pro/Max plan) instead of API credits. Planning, classification and escalations still use credits. Requires Claude Code installed and logged in.

enumDescriptions: Only run on your Claude Code subscription (Pro/Max). Never spend API credits; tasks fail if the subscription is unavailable.
Only run on API credits. Never use the subscription backend, even if logged in.
Prefer the subscription backend; fall back to API credits if the subscription is unavailable or over its limit.
Prefer API credits; fall back to the subscription backend if no API key is configured or credits fail.
claudeCoder.backendPreference.description: Which backend to run tasks on and how to fall back: subscriptionOnly, apiOnly, preferSubscription (default), or preferApi. Supersedes claudeCoder.useSubscription.

claudeCoder.subscriptionModel.description: Model alias for the subscription backend (sonnet | opus | haiku, or a full model id your plan supports).

claudeCoder.planningEnabled.description: Draft a short plan on the reasoning tier (Opus/Fable) before Sonnet implements it, for standard/hard tasks.

claudeCoder.requirePlanApproval.description: Pause and ask for approval before implementing a drafted plan. Only applies when planningEnabled is on and a plan was drafted.

claudeCoder.planningModelLadder.description: Planning model by complexity: index 0 for standard tasks, index 1 for hard tasks.

claudeCoder.planningMaxTokens.description: Hard cap on the planning call's output tokens per request (the reasoning tier is the most expensive per token). A plan that hits the cap auto-continues for up to 2 extra requests before being flagged as possibly incomplete.

claudeCoder.planningExploration.description: Let the planning model explore the codebase first (read-only grep/glob/read_file) so the plan cites real files and symbols. Its full reads also seed the lazy summary cache. Off = the old blind, tool-free plan.

claudeCoder.planningMaxToolCalls.description: Exploration budget for the planning model — the plan is forced once this many read-only tool calls have run.

claudeCoder.repoMapTokens.description: Token budget for the repo map fed to the planner: key files with declaration signatures, extracted from VS Code's language servers (no LLM cost, Aider-style). 0 disables it.

claudeCoder.compressLongPrompts.description: Use Haiku to shrink long, prose-heavy prompts (pasted logs/specs) before sending them to the main model. Off by default: it rewrites your own wording.

claudeCoder.compressionThresholdChars.description: Only compress prompts longer than this (characters).

claudeCoder.autoCompact.description: When a session's context passes compactionThresholdTokens, use Haiku to summarize the transcript and keep going instead of just warning.

claudeCoder.compactionMaxTokens.description: Output cap on the auto-compaction summary.

claudeCoder.autoApproveCommands.description: Run shell commands without asking for confirmation (risky).

claudeCoder.minimizeOutputTokens.description: Produce as few output tokens as possible: effort is clamped to 'low', extended thinking is disabled, and the model is instructed to work silently with terse edits and a one-sentence final answer. Output tokens cost 5x input.

claudeCoder.compactionThresholdTokens.description: When a request's input exceeds this, suggest starting a new session.

claudeCoder.rateLimitWarnThreshold.description: Show a warning notification when a subscription plan rate-limit window reaches this % utilization. Set to 0 to disable.
